title: Valve trombone versus slide trombone
summary: Allen and Williams compare valve trombone fingering with trumpet; Willie Connish was the last bell trombone player Williams knew.

story.theme_name: Trombonists: who they heard, admired and learned from
story.community_name: Talking trombonists: who played the slide and how
